entry.title: Pakistan’s changing development assistance landscape: Manifestations, implications, and opportunities
entry.summary:
Pakistan’s development assistance landscape is undergoing a major structural shift. Western bilateral aid is declining, multilateral development bank (MDB) financing is increasing to compensate, and non-Western bilateral and philanthropic flows are growing steadily. The post Pakistan’s changing development assistance landscape: Manifestations, implications, and opportunities appeared first on Atlantic Council .
